description: The shore at Prabhasa. The Yadavas descend into drunken madness and slaughter each other with blades of grass (hardened by Krishna's will). Gandhari's curse fulfilled. Mausala Parva — The Yadava Slaughter. Chaos, divine fate.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Harsh midday sun. Blood on sand.
interactive_elements: Blades of grass turned to iron
vn_backdrop_notes.note: Krishna watches his entire clan destroy itself. The curse he accepted from Gandhari manifests.
